about.lead: Green Net Power is an engineering and consulting company specializing in power systems. Our work spans load-flow, fault, and stability analysis; transmission planning; renewable energy feasibility; microgrid design; and power quality mitigation.
about.history: Since 2004, we have developed and delivered an automated, coordinated FACTS (UPFC) control system for the KEPCO Research Institute, participated in a national STATCOM coordinated-control R&D program, and conducted feasibility studies for 220 kV transmission lines in Mozambique and island microgrids in Ethiopia and the Philippines. More recent assignments address East Coast transmission constraints in Korea, national power system planning in Oman and Paraguay, and an electricity tariff negotiation framework for Ethiopia.
about.principle: Every engagement is grounded in power system analysis. We quantify the client’s operating challenge and present practical alternatives supported by engineering data—a principle that has guided our work for more than 20 years.

projects.title: Selected Experience
projects.intro: Selected assignments delivered for clients in Korea and abroad, from KEPCO R&D systems to national power-sector advisory programs.
projects.paraguayDescription: Advisory for Paraguay’s national transmission and substation development plan, reviewing system analysis, generation and network planning, and demand forecasts to identify economically sound options.
projects.ethiopiaTariffDescription: Development of a standardized framework for domestic tariff structures and international electricity trading negotiations to support tariff design and decision-making.
projects.omanDescription: Assessment of Oman’s power system, generation and transmission plans, and demand forecasts, with improvement options tailored to market conditions.
projects.koreaDescription: Completed an East Coast transmission-constraint mitigation study (2023), an Anin Unit 2 shared-use transmission-line review (2023), and a 154 kV transmission-cable slippage assessment (2024).
projects.mozambiqueTitle: Mozambique 220 kV Transmission Line Feasibility Studies
projects.mozambiqueDescription: Technical feasibility studies for the Namialo–Metoro (2015–16) and Metoro–Palma (2018) sections of Mozambique’s 220 kV transmission network.
projects.ethiopiaDescription: Feasibility and construction management for an off-grid hybrid system combining 250 kW of solar PV, 1,000 kWh of battery storage, and biomass and biodiesel generation.
projects.philippinesDescription: Technical advisory for the Logbon (Cobrador) Island solar-hybrid feasibility study and expansion plan, including participation in ADB Mini-Grid Subproject A.
projects.factsDescription: Developed and delivered a SCADA-integrated optimal operating system for the UPFC at Gangjin Substation to the KEPCO Research Institute. Also participated in a national R&D program for coordinated control of a 100 MVA-class STATCOM operated on the grid at Migeum Substation.
